note: Huron County (MI) publishes its zoning only as text ordinance PDFs. The official Zoning Districts Map is sold at the county office (Tax Mapping/GIS, 989-269-9421) for \$25, not offered as a queryable service. The county GIS page links only FetchGIS, a parcel/tax viewer with no zoning layer exposed. Cities checked: Bad Axe and Harbor Beach publish zoning as PDF ordinances only; no city zoning ArcGIS service found. Only zoning-bearing data found is commercial parcel products (Regrid, Dynamo, ReportAll), not public services.
